title: New Scheme Adaption Strategy for Hyperbolic Conservation Laws
summary: We introduce a new scheme adaption strategy for one- and two-dimensional hyperbolic systems of conservation laws. The proposed approach builds upon the adaptive framework introduced in [S. Chu, A. Kurganov, and I. Menshov, Appl. Numer. Math., 209 (2025), pp.155--170], where we first employed the smoothness indicator from [R. Lohner, Comput. Methods. Appl. Mech. Eng., 61 (1987), pp.323--338] to automatically detect ``rough'' and smooth parts of the computed solution, and then used different limiters in the detected regions.
